name: caching-strategy-chat
description: Caching strategy report from a public project URL, upload, or pasted notes. Same tier ladder as the advisor. Does not inspect a host tree.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include a project URL, attached or uploaded files, or pasted sources.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: strategy-report
outputs.description: Structured strategy report; empty when no usable evidence.
